activities.activity: Working the overnight shift at the aged-care residence: checking on residents, assisting with repositioning and personal care, preparing night drinks, and writing up detailed overnight observation notes
Commuting home from the aged-care facility by train and bus, reading the shift handover notes on his phone
Preparing and quietly eating a light breakfast of toast and fruit with a pot of tea after the night shift
Quick shower and change into clean sleep clothes, hanging the work uniform to air
Sleeping with the door closed and the fan on for white noise and quiet after the night shift
Waking up, washing his face and showering, and getting dressed for the rest of the day
Eating a late flexitarian lunch of reheated rice, lentils and vegetables with a mug of tea
Studying for his Master of Social Work at his desk: reading set texts, annotating lecture slides and drafting an assignment on the computer under the desk lamp
Doing written admin: updating his weekly budget, checking the rent and bill figures, and drafting written notes and reminders on his phone
Cooking a flexitarian dinner in weekly rotation: steaming rice in the rice cooker and stir-frying tofu and vegetables on the induction cooker
Eating dinner at the kitchen table with a cup of tea, following his usual no-alcohol routine
Washing the dishes, wiping the benches and returning shared kitchen items to their labelled places
Reviewing his written shift roster and study deadlines, updating his planner and setting phone alarms and reminders for the next few days
Quiet leisure at home: reading a book, drinking tea and looking at the photo of his family dog in China
Evening shower, dental care and night-time wind-down routine
Laying out clean clothes for tomorrow, setting his morning alarms and reminders, then reading quietly in bed
Sleeping in a quiet, dark room, with the fan on low
